title: A scalar rail control and a vector control
teaches: A control's :value is the document authority, written every frame to its optional :target and bound by :id in expressions. :min/:max are editor rails, not clamps. An xy control is a vector pin with its own default.
observe: depth writes gain = 0.25 and binds as 0.25 in mod.
pan is an xy pin with two lanes and a [0.25 0.5] default.
:min/:max are echoed in PACM but never clamp the write.
The frame order is track first, then gain, then pan-out.
